block.message: `prettier --write` rewrites whole files in this repo. Edit by hand and check `git diff --stat`.
`prisma format` rewrites the whole schema file. Edit prisma/schema.prisma by hand.
a phase-run session never migrates dev Neon. The test database and stj_cast take migrations on their own; the runner applies a new migration to dev Neon after the ticket's checks pass.

checks.note: --passWithNoTests: a ticket that changes no tested file (docs, a workflow) is not a failure. The receipt: a session runs this through tools/phase-run/stop-tests.mjs, and the stop check skips it on code that already passed.

phaseRun.note: Steak To Juan's phase runner, exactly what run.mjs hardcoded at 905e2d8 (Brigade's build step 7). The prose a session is given is examples/steak-to-juan/phase-run-prompt.md.

qa.note: scripts/qa-cast.ts's DB_NAME, in the Docker test container, under the loopback name the test database's address does not use: vitest.config.ts refuses to start when NEON_TEST_DATABASE_URL and NEON_DATABASE_URL look like one database, comparing the hostname alone for a host that is not Neon.

sessionEnv.note: .env holds the dev Neon address and the live Loyverse token, and node --env-file, prisma.config.ts, vitest.config.ts and each prisma/ script's loadDotEnv all read it; each leaves a variable alone once set. The R2 keys are left as they are: the QA app stores a captured photo with them.

gates.note: Typecheck, lint and the suite all pass on a client component that imports a file reaching Prisma; only the bundler refuses it (#54, #86, #89). The build never needs a database, and is pointed at the local one so Next reading .env cannot hand it dev Neon. A QA server left running holds .next open on Windows, hence freePorts.
